entry.title: Ola Englund - MEANS TO AN END

media:group.media:title: Ola Englund - MEANS TO AN END
media:group.media:description:
MEANS TO AN END – OUT NOW
My new single “Means To An End” is out now.
This was actually the last song I wrote for the new album, The Neverending Story. By the time I got to this one, the album was basically finished, but I felt like there was still something missing.
And this song became that final piece.
The Neverending Story will be released on October 14th.
You can listen to Means To An End now on YouTube, and if you want to support the album, you can preorder it here:
http://www.olaenglund.com/means
Thanks for listening and for supporting what I do.

media:group.media:title: SWOLA304 - OZZFEST RETURNS, MATT HEAFY LEAVING GIBSON? & WILLIAM SHATNER GOES METAL
media:group.media:description:
Sunday With Ola 304!
This week: Escape The Internet II is expanding to the UK, Ozzfest is coming back to the US in 2027, something seems to be happening between Matt Heafy and Gibson/Epiphone, I waste some time configuring Mesa/Boogies, Schecter drops a pretty wild Nick Johnston V and William Shatner is apparently doing heavy metal now.
In Adventures With Ola I unbox and photograph the new Solar Guitars Historia series, followed by the next part of the South American tour vlog from Buenos Aires, Argentina. And at the end I talk a little more about Pix, and answer a question I’ve been getting a lot lately. Thanks for watching. ❤️

entry.title: ENGL SAVAGE 30 – Small Amp, Serious Chug

media:group.media:title: ENGL SAVAGE 30 – Small Amp, Serious Chug
media:group.media:description:
The ENGL Savage 120 was my main live amp for years. Now I'm checking out the new ENGL Savage 30 (E611) — a smaller, 30-watt take on an amp I've always had a soft spot for.
In this episode of Ola Testing Shit, I run through the controls, talk about the EL34 power section, and put the lead channel through plenty of riffs and chugs. I test the low/high gain modes, contour switch and depth boost, try some different tunings with the Chug Capo, and yes... check the clean channel too.
Does it still have that Savage feel? Let's find out.
Would you go for the Savage 30 or the original Savage 120? Let me know in the comments.
CHAPTERS 00:00 Intro & opening demo 01:09 My history with the Savage 120 02:31 Channels & front-panel controls 03:14 EL34 power section 04:00 Power switching, noise gate & line out 04:31 Lead channel demo 04:52 High-gain mode & gain range 06:20 EQ & contour switch 06:59 Chug Capo & different tunings 09:04 Clean channel & volume balance 09:55 Depth boost 11:01 Low vs. high gain & more riffs 12:45 Final thoughts

entry.title: SWOLA303 - SLAYER REIGN IN BLOOD 40 YEARS, I WENT TO BRAZIL, BEHEMOTH, IBANEZ PII

media:group.media:title: SWOLA303 - SLAYER REIGN IN BLOOD 40 YEARS, I WENT TO BRAZIL, BEHEMOTH, IBANEZ PII
media:group.media:description:
Sunday With Ola 303!
This week we’re talking about Slayer celebrating 40 years of Reign In Blood by playing the entire album live, Behemoth teaming up with Shagrath from Dimmu Borgir, new music from Alissa White-Gluz and Blue Medusa, Ibanez continuing their ridiculous run of new guitars, and the new IK Multimedia TONEX Board.
We also check out the Finnish Radio Symphony Orchestra performing Finnish metal classics on national television, including music from Children of Bodom.
In Adventures With Ola I show you the compact touring pedalboard I’m using in South America with the Quad Cortex Mini and Darkglass MIDI pedal.
And finally, come along for the first day of our South American tour as The Haunted lands in São Paulo, Brazil and plays the first show of the run.
